description: This file defines a subclass of Doctrine's Table class, adding custom methods and maintaining a reference to an AbstractSchemaManager for schema operations within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 1 DTO utility.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A subclass of Doctrine's Table with added schema management features for OrangeHRM's DTO version 1 utilities.

methods.name: setSchemaManager
methods.description: Sets the schema manager instance for this Table object.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column to the table with specified options, returning the table instance for chaining.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Executes SQL to create the table in the database using the stored schema manager.
